name: @coding-adventures/matrix-rust-napi
description: Node.js N-API addon exposing the Rust matrix execution layer (matrix-ir, matrix-runtime, matrix-cpu) to JavaScript via the workspace node-bridge.  MX07 Phase 3 adds the build/smoke pipeline that produces the matrix_rust_napi.node artifact.

scripts.build: cargo build --release && (cp ../target/release/libmatrix_rust_napi.dylib matrix_rust_napi.node 2>/dev/null || cp ../target/release/libmatrix_rust_napi.so matrix_rust_napi.node 2>/dev/null || cp ../target/release/matrix_rust_napi.dll matrix_rust_napi.node 2>/dev/null || (echo 'matrix-rust-napi: no shared library found in ../target/release/'; exit 1))
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node -e "const m = require('./matrix_rust_napi.node'); if (typeof m.graphRoundTripJson !== 'function') throw new Error('graphRoundTripJson missing'); if (typeof m.runGraphOnCpu !== 'function') throw new Error('runGraphOnCpu missing'); if (typeof m.Graph !== 'function') throw new Error('Graph class missing'); if (typeof m.Runtime !== 'function') throw new Error('Runtime class missing'); console.log('matrix-rust-napi addon loaded; exports:', Object.keys(m).join(', '));"
